Hello, I love your style and was hoping that I could commission you to draw my vtuber Matcha Faun.

Matcha Faun is a deer boy that is also a witch. Matcha specializes in Tarot Card readings and alchemy. He uses spells to either get information he wants, to punish someone, or as surveillance. Matcha owns a tavern called the Lavender Tounge Tavern which is a cafe/bar deep in a mystical Forest. There he serves Coffee, tea, Alcohol, potions, and by far the most popular are his fortunes. 
His magic comes from his familiar which is a mystical bat with the body of a starry night sky that when it's tired stays in the crystal on Matcha's bowtie to replenish its magic. Matcha has named this bat Lavy, Lavy can turn into  a bat style Halberd if a weapon is needed, or a tall emaciated looking beast.
